name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
summary: Along Darkshore's coast, Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde watches the tides and the remains washing ashore. The night elf lives in Auberdine and sends travelers to examine strange sea creatures and massive turtles found dead on the northern beaches.

sections.title: Watcher of the Shifting Sands
sections.body: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde keeps watch over the coast from her home in Auberdine. While others in town tend to the forest or shipping across the Veiled Sea, she follows the shoreline. Lately, the tides have carried the remains of huge sea creatures onto the sands. She asks travelers to search the beaches, bring back skeletal samples, and learn what is happening in the waters offshore.

sections.title: The Stranded Giants
sections.body: North and south of Auberdine, more sea creatures and ancient sea turtles are washing ashore. Gwennyth asks travelers to inspect the bodies and bones. She hopes to learn what drove the creatures onto the beaches or killed them, and to understand the danger in the waters off northern Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde is a night elf in Auberdine, Darkshore, who studies strange changes along the shore. She sends travelers to survey the beaches and investigate what the sea has cast ashore.

faq.q: Where can I find Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde?
faq.answer: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde can be found in Auberdine, near the beach and docks on Darkshore's mist-shrouded coast.

faq.q: Why is she interested in beached creatures?
faq.answer: The dead sea turtles and other strange sea creatures may point to an imbalance or an unseen predator in the waters off Darkshore. Gwennyth examines remains from the coast to find the cause.
Gwennyth sends travelers to investigate the sea creatures and turtles washing ashore along Darkshore's coast, and receives their discoveries.

faq.q: Is she part of the Cenarion Circle or the Sentinels?
faq.answer: Gwennyth is a Priestess of the Moon who serves the Sisters of Elune in Auberdine. She is neither a Cenarion druid nor a Sentinel commander, though she shares her kin's concern for Darkshore's natural balance.
Gwennyth's surname, Bly'Leggonde, is an anagram of 'Leggy Blonde', a playful touch from the world's creators.

angles.text: For the kaldorei, the unnatural deaths of great sea beasts off Darkshore are a troubling sign of imbalance in their ancestral lands. Gwennyth's watch on the beaches matters deeply to them.
As a druid, you may see Gwennyth's reports of stranded sea life as an alarming sign of disturbance in Kalimdor's natural harmony.
As an Alliance traveler, you rely on Auberdine as the primary coastal port in northern Kalimdor. Safe waterways and beaches matter to all allied races traveling through.
